Our story

Meet Manar Ayoubi, the hands behind Macrame By Manar.

The maker behind the knots

A thread
worth following.

Macrame By Manar is the work of Manar Ayoubi, based in Btouratij, Koura. Her public portfolio brings together home decor, bags, accessories and souvenirs for occasions.

A fringed mirror, a textured vessel, a bag with a knotted flap: each photograph is a starting point for exploring the work. Save the references you like and speak with Manar about colour, size, current options and pricing.

Made in Btouratij, Koura, Lebanon.

Please contact Manar before visiting to confirm the location and a suitable time.
